name: AstroGrowth

sources.title: Homepage — e-commerce tool review/strategy blog ('impartial reviews'), active Sep 2026; no submit link
Contact Us — contact form plus contact@ / feedback@ / products@ email addresses; no product-submission form

requirements: Narrow fit: the site only reviews e-commerce and Amazon/Shopify seller tools — a general SaaS is out of scope
No public submission form or 'get listed' page exists anywhere in nav or footer; only a generic contact form and email addresses
Amazon affiliate + earnings disclaimers indicate monetization is affiliate-driven, not a pay-to-list directory
preparation: Confirm the product is an e-commerce / seller tool — otherwise do not pitch
One-paragraph pitch: what the tool does, pricing model, affiliate program (if any — likely helps since site is affiliate-monetized)
Product URL, screenshots, and a contact name
workflow: There is no submission route — pitch by emailing products@astrogrowth.com (listed for 'product concerns') or contact@astrogrowth.com
Alternatively use the form on https://www.astrogrowth.com/contact-us/
Offer an affiliate arrangement or review copy; an accepted pitch would appear as a tool review under /categories/ or a blog post
watchFor: No published acceptance criteria, turnaround, or listing format — this is a cold editorial pitch, not a directory submission
Content is heavily SEO/affiliate oriented ('Questioning X tools' skeptic-angle posts); coverage is not guaranteed to be positive
Sister-site email leak on contact page (feedback@veganliftz.com) suggests a small affiliate-blog network
countsAsLive: A review or category page for the product exists on astrogrowth.com and links to the product site
unknowns: Whether unsolicited pitches are accepted at all
Whether placement requires an affiliate deal or payment
Whether the site is still actively adding new tool reviews
